definitions.explanation: Fine, soft wool from the undercoat of the Kashmir goat, or cloth knitted or woven from it.

examples.japanese: カシミヤ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧。
カシミヤ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: A cashmere scarf is very warm.

examples.japanese: カシミヤ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Cashmere is delicate, so be careful when you wash it.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written カシミア, closer to the English spelling; both are common, and shops use either.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カシミヤ100%: pure cashmere
- カシミヤ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧: a cashmere coat
- カシミヤ{混|こん}: cashmere blend
